pages.title: Bryanston TV to bring sport, performance and school life… | Joymo
pages.main_text_excerpt:
Bryanston School has partnered with SOCS TV, powered by Joymo, to launch Bryanston TV, a secure, school-branded streaming and video platform for live and on-demand coverage of sport, performing arts, events and wider school life.
Bryanston TV will give pupils, parents, families, Old Bryanstonians and the wider school community a dedicated digital home for key moments across the School, helping them feel closer to life at Bryanston wherever they are in the world.
The platform will enable Bryanston to securely capture, manage and share a wide range of content, from sports fixtures and concerts to performances, talks, ceremonies, pupil showcases and community events, while keeping safeguarding, consent, school control and data protection at the centre.
Bryanston is one of the UK’s leading co-educational boarding and day schools, educating pupils aged 3-18 from its 450 acre campus in Dorset. The school is known for the Bryanston Method, its distinctive approach to education, which encourages pupils to think independently, take ownership of their learning and develop creativity, confidence and individuality.
That same spirit is reflected across Bryanston’s co-curricular life. The school offers around 100 extra-curricular activities each term, spanning sport, arts, music, academic societies, outdoor education and charity programmes. Sport and co-curricular activities are integral to daily life at Bryanston.
Bryanston TV will help bring more of this activity together in one place, allowing the school to celebrate the full breadth of pupil achievement while improving the experience for parents and families.
Hannah Attride, Bryanston’s Chief Commercial Officer, said:
“Bryanston is a community full of energy, creativity and achievement, and we are delighted to be launching Bryanston TV as a way of sharing more of those moments with parents, families and Old Bryanstonians. As we head into our centenary year, we are excited to be able to share these key moments with our community.
From sport and performance to talks, events and pupil-led projects, Bryanston TV will allow our community to feel closer to school life, wherever they are, while ensuring that content is shared in a secure and appropriate way.”
Built for school life: control, safeguarding and quality
SOCS TV, powered by Joymo, is designed specifically for schools. It enables institutions to livestream and publish on-demand content on a dedicated, school-branded platform, while retaining control over access, permissions, content ownership and data.
Key platform benefits include:
- Secure access and safeguarding-first streaming
- School control over content, permissions and retention
- Live and on-demand publishing on a dedicated, branded platform
- Consent-aware workflows and governance tools
- Data protection by design
Marius Larsen, COO/CFO of Joymo, said:
“Bryanston is exactly the kind of school SOCS TV was built for: ambitious, creative, deeply co-curricular and committed to giving pupils opportunities across sport, performance, leadership and wider school life.
With Bryanston TV, the School will have a secure, school-controlled digital home for live and on-demand content — helping parents, families and Old Bryanstonians stay connected to the moments that matter, without compromising safeguarding, consent or data control.
We are proud to support Bryanston with a platform built for education: ownership, governance and quality by design.”
James Kershaw Naylor, Director, Commercial & Product, SOCS, said:
“SOCS TV is a natural extension of how schools already use SOCS to manage and communicate co-curricular life. Schools need tools that fit into the rhythm of busy school environments, support staff rather than add complexity, and give parents a simple, trusted way to stay connected.
Bryanston TV will give the School a school-owned platform for sharing sport, performance and wider school events with its community, while ensuring that access, safeguarding and control remain where they should be: with the School.”
Availability
Bryanston TV is expected to launch for the Autumn Term in 2026. Further details, including how parents and the wider Bryanston community can access the platform, will be announced closer to launch.

pages.title: Joymo and SOCS partner to launch SOCS TV and revolutionise… | Joymo
pages.main_text_excerpt:
SOCS, a trusted leader in school sports and co-curricular management for 25 years, has selected Joymo, the leading direct-to-consumer live video platform for sports rights holders, to develop and build SOCS TV - a pioneering streaming and content management system for the UK and global education sector.
SOCS TV is set to launch this month, providing schools with a secure, high-quality content management system to broadcast events, sports, and activities—while ensuring safeguarding, ease of use, control, and affordability.
With SOCS TV, schools can capture content using anything from state-of-the-art cameras to mobile phones—making it easy to film on the go or during major events. All footage is securely stored on the school’s own platform, not the recording device, ensuring simple, safe, and centralised content management.
The partnership enables SOCS’s school customers - which accounts for over 85% of independent schools in the UK - to take full control of their video content, securely protected behind a registration wall. This ensures privacy, compliance, and new revenue opportunities, while enabling schools to livestream and share events, performances, and co-curricular activities on their own terms.
“Whether showcasing student achievements, broadcasting events, or enhancing learning, SOCS TV makes it simple for schools to share what matters most - safely and securely,“ comments Mike Emery, CEO, Joymo.
“This is a hugely meaningful partnership in terms of digital safeguarding. In the past, higher education partnerships have been seen as media rights or camera technology-led relationships, for Joymo and SOCS safeguarding of content has been paramount in the development of SOCS TV,” Emery added.
“As more schools film fixtures and other key events, much of this content ends up on platforms like YouTube or Vimeo and is stored on personal devices, often without the necessary consent or safeguards in place. We know how important it is to protect children’s privacy. That’s why SOCS TV puts schools fully in control.” says James Kershaw Naylor, Business Development Director, SOCS.
SOCS has built its reputation by seamlessly integrating with leading school management systems, portals, and specialist tools like Return2Play. Now, in response to school feedback, SOCS has partnered with Joymo to create a game-changing video solution for schools.
Founded in 2017, Joymo has a proven track record of delivering tailored media platforms for sports organisations across Europe, the UK, and the USA, covering sports like netball, baseball, basketball, and archery.
SOCS TV is now available for schools looking to enhance their events and sports coverage with a professional-grade streaming solution. Schools can seamlessly integrate SOCS TV within their existing SOCS ecosystem, making live and on-demand streaming effortless.
For more information, visit Joymo for Education.

pages.title: Joymo Expands England Netball Relationship With Multi-Year… | Joymo
pages.main_text_excerpt:
- Joymo secures multi-year partnership with England Netball to stream more than 330 live matches per season for the next three years
- Premier and Performance League fixtures showcasing some of the sports brightest talents to be streamed exclusively via englandnetball.tv
- England Netball launched the Joymo-powered englandnetball.tv platform last year
EN Premier League Play Offs 2023 - Credit Morgan Harlow
Joymo, the innovative video streaming services provider to sports rights holders, has secured a long-term agreement with England Netball to broadcast more than 330 live matches per season.
Under the terms of the deal, Joymo will stream 90 Premier League 1 matches - the highest level of club netball underneath the Netball Super League - plus further PL2 and PL3 games each season.
In addition, 200 games from the Netball Performance League, where some of the brightest young talents in England compete, will also be shown via the Joymo platform.
Fran Connolly, CEO of England Netball commented: “We’re really excited to be working with Joymo as our grassroots streaming partner. There is a lot of talent within the Premier League and the NPL and we’re pleased to be able to provide fans with a range of viewing options to enjoy more live netball.”
The new agreement follows the two organisations' prior collaboration that saw Joymo build and power England Netball’s direct-to-fan streaming platform englandnetball.tv, which launched last year.
The extended partnership empowers clubs competing in England Netball’s leading grassroots competitions the opportunity to deliver live streams via a single platform.
Through englandnetball.tv, fans will be able to choose from a range of all access league-based subscription packages watching or have the ability to purchase single-game tickets.*
“englandnetball.tv allows us to deliver more coverage of the sport in an easily accessible way. It is a crucial enabler for us to grow our fanbase and introduce more people to the sport,” Connolly added.
Hannah Griffiths, VP Content Acquisition & Partnerships at Joymo, said: “We are delighted to deepen our relationship with England Netball by aquiring the rights to these prestigious domestic competitions. Following the successful launch of englandnetball.tv last year, we want to ensure that more of the very best netball action is available to fans in the UK and beyond.
“The beauty of englandnetball.tv, and this new rights partnership, is that all of the best grassroots clubs and competitions will be accessible to fans via a single destination, making it easier than ever to engage with the sport,” Griffiths added.
The third round of the 2023-24 Premier League season takes place this Sunday with eight live matches available exclusively via englandnetball.tv.
*Premier League 1 and Netball Performance League All Access passes available for £59.99 per annum. Premier League 1 All Access only, for £49.99. Premier League 2 and Premier League 3 team passes for £29.99. All matches will be available at the pay-per-view cost of £5.99.

pages.title: Joymo Scores Long-Term National Futsal Series Streaming… | Joymo
pages.main_text_excerpt:
Joymo, the live video streaming platform for event organisers at every level of the sporting pyramid, has entered a long-term partnership with The FA National Futsal Series (NFS) to power nationalfutsal.tv, a new digital home for the sport in the England.
As the new, exclusive, provider of the NFS’ owned and operated direct-to-fan streaming services, Joymo has developed and built the new digital content platform which will broadcast all Tier 1 men’s (90 games) and women’s (70 games) fixtures during the 2024/2025 season.
The nationalfutsal.tv hub - the exclusive home to all National Futsal Series content - is now live ahead of the start of the new season commencing this Saturday (September 21) when the Women's Tier 1 competition kicks-off.
From the 2025/2026 season, the NFS has committed to streaming all Tier 1 and Tier 2 fixtures - 480 in total. This season, the NFS will strive to stream as many of the 320 Tier 2 matches as possible.
Commenting on the partnership, Chris Parkin, Director & Chair of League Management Committee at National Futsal Series, said:
“We are absolutely thrilled to offer futsal fans across the country, and around the world, access to live National Futsal Series matches via nationalfutsal.tv, this season and beyond. This is a major development for the sport in England. Our investment will elevate the quality of our broadcast coverage and give fans greater access to watch their favourite teams and players week-in, week-out. We now have a digital home for the sport that should excite futsal players and fans everywhere.”
Marius Larsen, Chief Operating Officer at Joymo, commented’
“Its been a joy to work with the National Futsal Series and we are grateful that they recognised Joymo’s technical expertise and experience in developing bespoke digital streaming solutions and selected us to drive their digital content ambitions. It’s an exciting moment to see nationalfutsal.tv go live ahead of the new season, one that promises to reach more fans than ever before, powering the growth of the sport for generations to come.”
Live coverage on nationalfutsal.tv will kick-off at 14:45 on Saturday (September 21) with Southampton Aztecs Women taking on Bloomsbury Women, followed by current champions Bolton Women versus Birmingham WLV Women (15:05 – 17:05), London Helvecia Ladies against Bedford Ladies (15:15 – 17:15), and Derby Women versus Hartpury Women (16:45 – 18:45).
Coverage of the 10-team Men’s Tier 1 league will start on October 13 as Manchester look to retain their title.
National Futsal Series live matches will be available to access via an annual subscription (£39.99) or a pay-as-you-go monthly pass (£6.99). For more information on upcoming live streams and subscription offers, including team discounts, please visit nationalfutsal.tv.

pages.title: Joymo Strikes IMMAF Partnership To Power New Global Streaming… | Joymo
pages.main_text_excerpt:
The International Mixed Martial Arts Federation (IMMAF) has selected leading direct-to-fan streaming platform provider, Joymo, to revamp and power IMMAF.tv, creating a new digital content hub for the global body for MMA.
The dedicated video streaming platform launched with live coverage of the IMMAF Youth World Championships in Al Ain, which registered record-breaking social media reach and athlete participation.
Coverage of the event was streamed in 48 countries, from Austria to Angola and Mauritius to Mongolia, via IMMAF.tv, registering more than 170,000 content plays and over 750 days-worth of cumulative watch-time.
The platform will continue to broadcast exclusive live and on-demand content from IMMAF events. Including the 2025 IMMAF World Championships in Tbilisi, Georgia, (September 27 - October 2) and the 2025 IMMAF Pan American Championships from Monterrey, Mexico (November 16-22).
“With an estimated audience of nearly half a billion people globally, Mixed Martial Arts is the fastest-growing sport in the world. Our goal is to make IMMAF.tv the number one destination for the amateur side of the sport, using Joymo's technology to meet the demand of that rapidly expanding fanbase, eager for more MMA coverage,” said IMMAF CEO, Densign White.
“IMMAF's focus on developing amateur mixed martial arts globally, means that increased event coverage is crucial and with our first event with Joymo, we engaged fans in 48 countries who consumed hundreds of thousands of hours of competition. Joymo is helping us enhance the visibility of MMA and provides control over our data, audience, and commercial assets, creating a sustainable and strategic model for long-term growth,” White continued.
“Joymo is delighted that the IMMAF recognised our technical expertise and experience in developing bespoke digital streaming solutions to power IMMAF.tv, a crucial platform for MMA's continued growth,” commented Joymo’s, Chief Operating Officer, Marius Larsen.
“This partnership will help expand the sport from recreational to elite levels and build stronger connections with athletes, members, and fans, underpinning the next phase of MMA's incredible growth trajectory.
“IMMAF.tv enables deeper and broader coverage of IMMAF events and provides the organisation with audience data, insights, and commercial opportunities that will help to grow the sport for generations to come,” said Larsen.
Founded in 2012, IMMAF organises elite amateur nations tournaments all over the world, through its flagship World and Continental Championships for Seniors, Juniors and Youths from the ages of 10 years upwards.
MMA fans can access IMMAF.tv via a monthly subscription (£8.99) or a pay-per-view event pass specific for the event, which enables live or on demand for 21 days from the first watch. The service is available via smartphone, tablet or laptop and on smart TVs via Chromecast or AirPlay.
For more information and to view the full schedule of live events, visit IMMAF.tv.

pages.title: Joymo Strikes World Baseball And Softball Confederation… | Joymo
pages.main_text_excerpt:
Joymo has secured a long-term partnership with the World Baseball Softball Confederation Europe as the exclusive provider of its owned and operated over-the-top (OTT) streaming services.
The agreement, confirmed after a competitive pitch process, has seen Joymo develop and build a new digital content platform baseballeurope.tv which launched May 15th to broadcast the sports biggest European events to subscribing audiences worldwide. 
The new baseballeurope.tv homepage
As the confederation for Baseball and Softball in Europe, including governance of all European level National Teams and Club competitions, WBSC Europe organises 27 tournaments per year, with the vast majority to be streamed on the platform.
In total, more than 700 games will be broadcast direct to fans in the first year of the Joymo-powered service, starting with the newly-created Baseball European Champions Cup with the opening matches taking place on May 15 with the platform launch.
Discussing the partnership, WBSC Europe President, Kruno Karin, said: “This is a significant moment for our sports and the Confederation. In order to grow our games we know that we have to provide more access to quality live content and the partnership with Joymo enables us to do that on a global basis. Our investment elevates the production of our events dramatically and creates a true digital home for the sport which should excite baseball and softball fans everywhere.”
“We are delighted that Joymo’s technical expertise and experience in developing bespoke digital streaming solutions has been recognised by WBSC Europe,” commented Mike Emery, CEO at Joymo.
“We have worked hand-in-hand with WBSC Europe to develop the baseballeurope.tv platform and we will continue to be a strategic support to ensure high quality streams are delivered, and more fans are reached than ever before, powering the growth of the sport for generations to come.”
WBSC Europe events will be available for fans to access with bespoke tournament passes available from €14.99, with the option to purchase single games on a pay-per-view basis. For more information on upcoming live streams and subscription offers please visit baseballeurope.tv.

pages.title: Joymo to power World Boxing TV | Joymo
pages.main_text_excerpt:
Lausanne, 15 June 2026 — Joymo has partnered with World Boxing to power World Boxing TV, a dedicated streaming platform for live and on-demand boxing content.
World Boxing TV will give fans a central destination to follow World Boxing events, broadcasts and highlights, helping bring the sport closer to audiences across the world. The platform is powered by Joymo’s OTT technology, which is built for sports organisations that want to manage their own content, build direct fan relationships and create new digital revenue opportunities.
The partnership supports World Boxing’s ambition to develop a sustainable, inclusive and transparent global structure for boxing, with athletes and fair competition at its centre. By launching World Boxing TV, World Boxing will be able to strengthen the visibility of its competitions, showcase athletes and provide fans with easier access to official content.
Joymo’s platform enables rights holders to deliver live and on-demand video, manage content, access first-party data and support different commercial models, including subscriptions, pay-per-view and event-based access. The service is designed to help sports organisations build their own branded digital destinations while retaining control of their audience, content, data and commercial strategy.
World Boxing TV is now available as a dedicated streaming destination for World Boxing content.

pages.title: Repton School signs with SOCS TV, powered by Joymo, to launch… | Joymo
pages.main_text_excerpt:
Repton School has signed with SOCS TV, powered by Joymo, to power Repton.TV, its dedicated school streaming platform for live and on-demand coverage of co-curricular and extra-curricular life across the School.
The partnership will support Repton in securely capturing, managing and sharing a wide range of school activity — including sport, performances, events, lectures, ceremonies, pupil showcases, and other key moments in school life — with parents, families, alumni and the wider Repton community through a professional, school-branded platform.
Repton.TV will provide the School with a secure digital home for content that reflects the full breadth of the Repton experience. By bringing streaming and video publishing into a platform designed specifically for schools, Repton will be able to share more of what makes school life distinctive, while maintaining the standards of safeguarding, consent, control and quality expected in an education setting.
Gareth James, Director of Sport and Assistant Head Co-Curricular, said:
“Repton has always placed enormous value on the breadth of opportunity available beyond the classroom, and we are delighted to be launching Repton.TV. This platform will allow parents, families and the wider Repton community to feel even more connected to school life, wherever they are in the world.
This development will celebrate the remarkable participation and achievements of our pupils across the co-curriculum. Importantly, it enables us to share these moments in a way that reflects the high standards and strong sense of community that sit at the heart of a Repton education”
Built for school life: control, safeguarding and quality
SOCS TV, powered by Joymo, is designed specifically for schools. It enables institutions to livestream and publish on-demand content on a dedicated, school-branded platform, while retaining control over access, permissions, content ownership and data.
For Repton, that means the ability to create a trusted digital destination for school life beyond the classroom — one that can support everything from concerts, drama productions and speaker events to prizegivings, house activity, pupil-led content and selected sports coverage, all within a framework built for education.
James Kershaw Naylor, Director, Commercial & Product, SOCS, said:
“Schools create an enormous amount of meaningful activity beyond the classroom, but too often there has not been a platform built specifically to showcase it in the right way. SOCS TV gives schools like Repton a secure, school-controlled way to share the richness of their co-curricular life with families and communities, while keeping governance and safeguarding at the centre.”
Marius Larsen, COO/CFO of Joymo, said:
“Repton has a strong identity, a vibrant school community and a co-curricular programme that deserves to be seen and celebrated in a way that matches the standards of the School itself. Through SOCS TV, powered by Joymo, Repton can continue building a trusted digital home for live and on-demand content across school life — not just for sport, but for the wider moments, achievements and experiences that define a school community. We are proud to support Repton with a platform built around ownership, governance and quality by design.”

pages.title: Rugby School signs with SOCS TV, Powered to Joymo, to launch… | Joymo
pages.main_text_excerpt:
Rugby School, one of the country’s leading co-educational boarding schools, has partnered with SOCS TV, powered by Joymo, to launch Rugby School TV, a secure, school-branded streaming and video platform that will bring fixtures, performances, talks and seminars to parents, families, alumni and the wider Rugby School community, wherever they are in the world.
Launching in Q2 2026, Rugby School TV will enable the School to livestream and publish on-demand content with safeguarding, consent and school control at the core. SOCS TV is built specifically for schools, giving Rugby School full ownership of its content and data, alongside governance and privacy tools to support compliance.
“Sport at Rugby is for everyone,” Rugby School notes in its co-curricular programme, underlining an inclusive sporting culture with broad participation and a vibrant calendar of school life. With over 40 sporting fixtures per week the School’s commitment to developing the whole person is reflected in a rich programme that brings more moments that matter to the global family of Rugbeians.
Rugby School TV will extend that connection beyond the sports fields, with a focus on streaming key cultural events in one place for parents. From House Singing, to Coffee Concerts, Concerto Concerts to Scholars’ Plays, Rugby School TV will knit the vibrant co-curricular programme together helping parents stay close to key moments while ensuring appropriate safeguarding controls are in place.
Gareth Parker-Jones, Head Master, Rugby School, said:
“I am delighted that the launch of Rugby School TV will allow members of the wider Rugbeian community, particularly those who cannot regularly be in Rugby, to share in the rich academic, cultural and sporting life of the School. This is particularly valuable for parents who live some distance away. This platform will bring them closer to the Rugby experience, enabling them to witness and enjoy the many activities their children take part in.”
Lee Shepherd, Deputy Head Co-Curricular, said:
“At Rugby School, we have streamed a significant number of school-wide events over many years, but our partnership with SOCS TV will bring all of our content together on a single platform, significantly improving the parental experience. We are incredibly proud of what we offer our students, and as a full boarding school we want to share more of these moments with our wider parent community.”
Built for school life: control, safeguarding and quality
SOCS TV, powered by Joymo, is designed to help schools securely capture and share content—from major fixtures and productions to everyday milestones—without defaulting to open consumer platforms. Key platform benefits include:
- Secure access and safeguarding-first streaming (including consent-aware workflows and governance tools)
- School control over content, permissions and retention
- Live and on-demand publishing on a dedicated, school-branded platform
- Data protection by design and tools aligned to GDPR and KCSIE 2024 expectations
James Kershaw Naylor, Director, Commercial & Product, SOCS, said: “SOCS TV puts schools fully in control—so they can share what matters most, safely, with the right safeguards in place.”
Marius Larsen, COO/CFO of Joymo, said:
“Rugby School is setting a clear standard for how schools can share sport and wider school life in a way that strengthens community without compromising safeguarding. Through SOCS TV, powered by Joymo, Rugby School will have a secure, school-controlled digital home for live and on-demand content—so parents, families and alumni can feel close to the moments that matter, wherever they are. We are proud to support Rugby School with a platform built for education: ownership, governance and quality by design.”
Availability
Rugby School TV is scheduled to launch in Q2 2026. Further details—including where to access Rugby School TV, the initial content programme, and viewer registration—will be announced closer to launch.

pages.title: World Archery Partners With Joymo to Upgrade archery+… | Joymo
pages.main_text_excerpt:
Joymo has secured a wide-ranging partnership with World Archery encompassing the development of its archery+ online streaming platform, and the digital broadcast of its marquee events, on a multi-year basis.
Under the terms of the alliance, World Archery, the international federation for the sport of archery, has appointed Joymo as the exclusive provider of its owned and operated over-the-top (OTT) streaming services.
The relationship has seen Joymo develop and build a brand new archery.tv product, which will continue to be powered by Joymo, and broadcast the sport’s biggest events to subscribing audiences worldwide.
World Archery will exclusively stream marquee events like the Hyundai Archery World Cup, the Hyundai World Archery Championships and major regional tournaments on the platform, making it the single destination for archery fans to enjoy the sport.
archery+ will also host features, documentaries, educational resources and other exclusive content developed by World Archery, including qualification events for Paris 2024 and exclusive #ArcheryinParis content during the summer.
Commenting on the agreement, World Archery secretary general, Tom Dielen, said: “We’re partnering with Joymo to create a video hub for archery’s large catalogue of event and feature content, which will now be available in one location to every fan worldwide. Not only will this partnership make the sport easier to access but also allow us to invest additional resources into live production, engaging series and exciting new formats.”
Hannah Griffiths, VP of Content Acquisition & Partnerships at Joymo, said: “We are delighted that our technical expertise and experience in developing bespoke digital streaming solutions has been recognised by World Archery. This is exactly the type of full-cycle relationship that Joymo thrives on; creating and managing the product but also acquiring top-tier rights so that we are best positioned to support our partners in the long-term growth of their platforms.”
The full suite of archery+ live and exclusive content will be available to access with an annual subscription at a cost of €49.99. Pay-per-view event passes will also be available. Please visit archery.tv for more information.

pages.title: Bryanston TV to bring sport, performance and school life… | Joymo
pages.main_text_excerpt:
Bryanston School has partnered with SOCS TV, powered by Joymo, to launch Bryanston TV, a secure, school-branded streaming and video platform for live and on-demand coverage of sport, performing arts, events and wider school life.
Bryanston TV will give pupils, parents, families, Old Bryanstonians and the wider school community a dedicated digital home for key moments across the School, helping them feel closer to life at Bryanston wherever they are in the world.
The platform will enable Bryanston to securely capture, manage and share a wide range of content, from sports fixtures and concerts to performances, talks, ceremonies, pupil showcases and community events, while keeping safeguarding, consent, school control and data protection at the centre.
Bryanston is one of the UK’s leading co-educational boarding and day schools, educating pupils aged 3-18 from its 450 acre campus in Dorset. The school is known for the Bryanston Method, its distinctive approach to education, which encourages pupils to think independently, take ownership of their learning and develop creativity, confidence and individuality.
That same spirit is reflected across Bryanston’s co-curricular life. The school offers around 100 extra-curricular activities each term, spanning sport, arts, music, academic societies, outdoor education and charity programmes. Sport and co-curricular activities are integral to daily life at Bryanston.
Bryanston TV will help bring more of this activity together in one place, allowing the school to celebrate the full breadth of pupil achievement while improving the experience for parents and families.
Hannah Attride, Bryanston’s Chief Commercial Officer, said:
“Bryanston is a community full of energy, creativity and achievement, and we are delighted to be launching Bryanston TV as a way of sharing more of those moments with parents, families and Old Bryanstonians. As we head into our centenary year, we are excited to be able to share these key moments with our community.
From sport and performance to talks, events and pupil-led projects, Bryanston TV will allow our community to feel closer to school life, wherever they are, while ensuring that content is shared in a secure and appropriate way.”
Built for school life: control, safeguarding and quality
SOCS TV, powered by Joymo, is designed specifically for schools. It enables institutions to livestream and publish on-demand content on a dedicated, school-branded platform, while retaining control over access, permissions, content ownership and data.
Key platform benefits include:
- Secure access and safeguarding-first streaming
- School control over content, permissions and retention
- Live and on-demand publishing on a dedicated, branded platform
- Consent-aware workflows and governance tools
- Data protection by design
Marius Larsen, COO/CFO of Joymo, said:
“Bryanston is exactly the kind of school SOCS TV was built for: ambitious, creative, deeply co-curricular and committed to giving pupils opportunities across sport, performance, leadership and wider school life.
With Bryanston TV, the School will have a secure, school-controlled digital home for live and on-demand content — helping parents, families and Old Bryanstonians stay connected to the moments that matter, without compromising safeguarding, consent or data control.
We are proud to support Bryanston with a platform built for education: ownership, governance and quality by design.”
James Kershaw Naylor, Director, Commercial & Product, SOCS, said:
“SOCS TV is a natural extension of how schools already use SOCS to manage and communicate co-curricular life. Schools need tools that fit into the rhythm of busy school environments, support staff rather than add complexity, and give parents a simple, trusted way to stay connected.
Bryanston TV will give the School a school-owned platform for sharing sport, performance and wider school events with its community, while ensuring that access, safeguarding and control remain where they should be: with the School.”
Availability
Bryanston TV is expected to launch for the Autumn Term in 2026. Further details, including how parents and the wider Bryanston community can access the platform, will be announced closer to launch.

pages.title: Joymo and SOCS partner to launch SOCS TV and revolutionise… | Joymo
pages.main_text_excerpt:
SOCS, a trusted leader in school sports and co-curricular management for 25 years, has selected Joymo, the leading direct-to-consumer live video platform for sports rights holders, to develop and build SOCS TV - a pioneering streaming and content management system for the UK and global education sector.
SOCS TV is set to launch this month, providing schools with a secure, high-quality content management system to broadcast events, sports, and activities—while ensuring safeguarding, ease of use, control, and affordability.
With SOCS TV, schools can capture content using anything from state-of-the-art cameras to mobile phones—making it easy to film on the go or during major events. All footage is securely stored on the school’s own platform, not the recording device, ensuring simple, safe, and centralised content management.
The partnership enables SOCS’s school customers - which accounts for over 85% of independent schools in the UK - to take full control of their video content, securely protected behind a registration wall. This ensures privacy, compliance, and new revenue opportunities, while enabling schools to livestream and share events, performances, and co-curricular activities on their own terms.
“Whether showcasing student achievements, broadcasting events, or enhancing learning, SOCS TV makes it simple for schools to share what matters most - safely and securely,“ comments Mike Emery, CEO, Joymo.
“This is a hugely meaningful partnership in terms of digital safeguarding. In the past, higher education partnerships have been seen as media rights or camera technology-led relationships, for Joymo and SOCS safeguarding of content has been paramount in the development of SOCS TV,” Emery added.
“As more schools film fixtures and other key events, much of this content ends up on platforms like YouTube or Vimeo and is stored on personal devices, often without the necessary consent or safeguards in place. We know how important it is to protect children’s privacy. That’s why SOCS TV puts schools fully in control.” says James Kershaw Naylor, Business Development Director, SOCS.
SOCS has built its reputation by seamlessly integrating with leading school management systems, portals, and specialist tools like Return2Play. Now, in response to school feedback, SOCS has partnered with Joymo to create a game-changing video solution for schools.
Founded in 2017, Joymo has a proven track record of delivering tailored media platforms for sports organisations across Europe, the UK, and the USA, covering sports like netball, baseball, basketball, and archery.
SOCS TV is now available for schools looking to enhance their events and sports coverage with a professional-grade streaming solution. Schools can seamlessly integrate SOCS TV within their existing SOCS ecosystem, making live and on-demand streaming effortless.
For more information, visit Joymo for Education.

pages.title: Joymo Expands England Netball Relationship With Multi-Year… | Joymo
pages.main_text_excerpt:
- Joymo secures multi-year partnership with England Netball to stream more than 330 live matches per season for the next three years
- Premier and Performance League fixtures showcasing some of the sports brightest talents to be streamed exclusively via englandnetball.tv
- England Netball launched the Joymo-powered englandnetball.tv platform last year
EN Premier League Play Offs 2023 - Credit Morgan Harlow
Joymo, the innovative video streaming services provider to sports rights holders, has secured a long-term agreement with England Netball to broadcast more than 330 live matches per season.
Under the terms of the deal, Joymo will stream 90 Premier League 1 matches - the highest level of club netball underneath the Netball Super League - plus further PL2 and PL3 games each season.
In addition, 200 games from the Netball Performance League, where some of the brightest young talents in England compete, will also be shown via the Joymo platform.
Fran Connolly, CEO of England Netball commented: “We’re really excited to be working with Joymo as our grassroots streaming partner. There is a lot of talent within the Premier League and the NPL and we’re pleased to be able to provide fans with a range of viewing options to enjoy more live netball.”
The new agreement follows the two organisations' prior collaboration that saw Joymo build and power England Netball’s direct-to-fan streaming platform englandnetball.tv, which launched last year.
The extended partnership empowers clubs competing in England Netball’s leading grassroots competitions the opportunity to deliver live streams via a single platform.
Through englandnetball.tv, fans will be able to choose from a range of all access league-based subscription packages watching or have the ability to purchase single-game tickets.*
“englandnetball.tv allows us to deliver more coverage of the sport in an easily accessible way. It is a crucial enabler for us to grow our fanbase and introduce more people to the sport,” Connolly added.
Hannah Griffiths, VP Content Acquisition & Partnerships at Joymo, said: “We are delighted to deepen our relationship with England Netball by aquiring the rights to these prestigious domestic competitions. Following the successful launch of englandnetball.tv last year, we want to ensure that more of the very best netball action is available to fans in the UK and beyond.
“The beauty of englandnetball.tv, and this new rights partnership, is that all of the best grassroots clubs and competitions will be accessible to fans via a single destination, making it easier than ever to engage with the sport,” Griffiths added.
The third round of the 2023-24 Premier League season takes place this Sunday with eight live matches available exclusively via englandnetball.tv.
*Premier League 1 and Netball Performance League All Access passes available for £59.99 per annum. Premier League 1 All Access only, for £49.99. Premier League 2 and Premier League 3 team passes for £29.99. All matches will be available at the pay-per-view cost of £5.99.

pages.title: Joymo Scores Long-Term National Futsal Series Streaming… | Joymo
pages.main_text_excerpt:
Joymo, the live video streaming platform for event organisers at every level of the sporting pyramid, has entered a long-term partnership with The FA National Futsal Series (NFS) to power nationalfutsal.tv, a new digital home for the sport in the England.
As the new, exclusive, provider of the NFS’ owned and operated direct-to-fan streaming services, Joymo has developed and built the new digital content platform which will broadcast all Tier 1 men’s (90 games) and women’s (70 games) fixtures during the 2024/2025 season.
The nationalfutsal.tv hub - the exclusive home to all National Futsal Series content - is now live ahead of the start of the new season commencing this Saturday (September 21) when the Women's Tier 1 competition kicks-off.
From the 2025/2026 season, the NFS has committed to streaming all Tier 1 and Tier 2 fixtures - 480 in total. This season, the NFS will strive to stream as many of the 320 Tier 2 matches as possible.
Commenting on the partnership, Chris Parkin, Director & Chair of League Management Committee at National Futsal Series, said:
“We are absolutely thrilled to offer futsal fans across the country, and around the world, access to live National Futsal Series matches via nationalfutsal.tv, this season and beyond. This is a major development for the sport in England. Our investment will elevate the quality of our broadcast coverage and give fans greater access to watch their favourite teams and players week-in, week-out. We now have a digital home for the sport that should excite futsal players and fans everywhere.”
Marius Larsen, Chief Operating Officer at Joymo, commented’
“Its been a joy to work with the National Futsal Series and we are grateful that they recognised Joymo’s technical expertise and experience in developing bespoke digital streaming solutions and selected us to drive their digital content ambitions. It’s an exciting moment to see nationalfutsal.tv go live ahead of the new season, one that promises to reach more fans than ever before, powering the growth of the sport for generations to come.”
Live coverage on nationalfutsal.tv will kick-off at 14:45 on Saturday (September 21) with Southampton Aztecs Women taking on Bloomsbury Women, followed by current champions Bolton Women versus Birmingham WLV Women (15:05 – 17:05), London Helvecia Ladies against Bedford Ladies (15:15 – 17:15), and Derby Women versus Hartpury Women (16:45 – 18:45).
Coverage of the 10-team Men’s Tier 1 league will start on October 13 as Manchester look to retain their title.
National Futsal Series live matches will be available to access via an annual subscription (£39.99) or a pay-as-you-go monthly pass (£6.99). For more information on upcoming live streams and subscription offers, including team discounts, please visit nationalfutsal.tv.

pages.title: Joymo Strikes IMMAF Partnership To Power New Global Streaming… | Joymo
pages.main_text_excerpt:
The International Mixed Martial Arts Federation (IMMAF) has selected leading direct-to-fan streaming platform provider, Joymo, to revamp and power IMMAF.tv, creating a new digital content hub for the global body for MMA.
The dedicated video streaming platform launched with live coverage of the IMMAF Youth World Championships in Al Ain, which registered record-breaking social media reach and athlete participation.
Coverage of the event was streamed in 48 countries, from Austria to Angola and Mauritius to Mongolia, via IMMAF.tv, registering more than 170,000 content plays and over 750 days-worth of cumulative watch-time.
The platform will continue to broadcast exclusive live and on-demand content from IMMAF events. Including the 2025 IMMAF World Championships in Tbilisi, Georgia, (September 27 - October 2) and the 2025 IMMAF Pan American Championships from Monterrey, Mexico (November 16-22).
“With an estimated audience of nearly half a billion people globally, Mixed Martial Arts is the fastest-growing sport in the world. Our goal is to make IMMAF.tv the number one destination for the amateur side of the sport, using Joymo's technology to meet the demand of that rapidly expanding fanbase, eager for more MMA coverage,” said IMMAF CEO, Densign White.
“IMMAF's focus on developing amateur mixed martial arts globally, means that increased event coverage is crucial and with our first event with Joymo, we engaged fans in 48 countries who consumed hundreds of thousands of hours of competition. Joymo is helping us enhance the visibility of MMA and provides control over our data, audience, and commercial assets, creating a sustainable and strategic model for long-term growth,” White continued.
“Joymo is delighted that the IMMAF recognised our technical expertise and experience in developing bespoke digital streaming solutions to power IMMAF.tv, a crucial platform for MMA's continued growth,” commented Joymo’s, Chief Operating Officer, Marius Larsen.
“This partnership will help expand the sport from recreational to elite levels and build stronger connections with athletes, members, and fans, underpinning the next phase of MMA's incredible growth trajectory.
“IMMAF.tv enables deeper and broader coverage of IMMAF events and provides the organisation with audience data, insights, and commercial opportunities that will help to grow the sport for generations to come,” said Larsen.
Founded in 2012, IMMAF organises elite amateur nations tournaments all over the world, through its flagship World and Continental Championships for Seniors, Juniors and Youths from the ages of 10 years upwards.
MMA fans can access IMMAF.tv via a monthly subscription (£8.99) or a pay-per-view event pass specific for the event, which enables live or on demand for 21 days from the first watch. The service is available via smartphone, tablet or laptop and on smart TVs via Chromecast or AirPlay.
For more information and to view the full schedule of live events, visit IMMAF.tv.

pages.title: Joymo Strikes World Baseball And Softball Confederation… | Joymo
pages.main_text_excerpt:
Joymo has secured a long-term partnership with the World Baseball Softball Confederation Europe as the exclusive provider of its owned and operated over-the-top (OTT) streaming services.
The agreement, confirmed after a competitive pitch process, has seen Joymo develop and build a new digital content platform baseballeurope.tv which launched May 15th to broadcast the sports biggest European events to subscribing audiences worldwide. 
The new baseballeurope.tv homepage
As the confederation for Baseball and Softball in Europe, including governance of all European level National Teams and Club competitions, WBSC Europe organises 27 tournaments per year, with the vast majority to be streamed on the platform.
In total, more than 700 games will be broadcast direct to fans in the first year of the Joymo-powered service, starting with the newly-created Baseball European Champions Cup with the opening matches taking place on May 15 with the platform launch.
Discussing the partnership, WBSC Europe President, Kruno Karin, said: “This is a significant moment for our sports and the Confederation. In order to grow our games we know that we have to provide more access to quality live content and the partnership with Joymo enables us to do that on a global basis. Our investment elevates the production of our events dramatically and creates a true digital home for the sport which should excite baseball and softball fans everywhere.”
“We are delighted that Joymo’s technical expertise and experience in developing bespoke digital streaming solutions has been recognised by WBSC Europe,” commented Mike Emery, CEO at Joymo.
“We have worked hand-in-hand with WBSC Europe to develop the baseballeurope.tv platform and we will continue to be a strategic support to ensure high quality streams are delivered, and more fans are reached than ever before, powering the growth of the sport for generations to come.”
WBSC Europe events will be available for fans to access with bespoke tournament passes available from €14.99, with the option to purchase single games on a pay-per-view basis. For more information on upcoming live streams and subscription offers please visit baseballeurope.tv.

pages.title: Joymo to power World Boxing TV | Joymo
pages.main_text_excerpt:
Lausanne, 15 June 2026 — Joymo has partnered with World Boxing to power World Boxing TV, a dedicated streaming platform for live and on-demand boxing content.
World Boxing TV will give fans a central destination to follow World Boxing events, broadcasts and highlights, helping bring the sport closer to audiences across the world. The platform is powered by Joymo’s OTT technology, which is built for sports organisations that want to manage their own content, build direct fan relationships and create new digital revenue opportunities.
The partnership supports World Boxing’s ambition to develop a sustainable, inclusive and transparent global structure for boxing, with athletes and fair competition at its centre. By launching World Boxing TV, World Boxing will be able to strengthen the visibility of its competitions, showcase athletes and provide fans with easier access to official content.
Joymo’s platform enables rights holders to deliver live and on-demand video, manage content, access first-party data and support different commercial models, including subscriptions, pay-per-view and event-based access. The service is designed to help sports organisations build their own branded digital destinations while retaining control of their audience, content, data and commercial strategy.
World Boxing TV is now available as a dedicated streaming destination for World Boxing content.

pages.title: Repton School signs with SOCS TV, powered by Joymo, to launch… | Joymo

Built for school life: control, safeguarding and quality

“Schools create an enormous amount of meaningful activity beyond the classroom, but too often there has not been a platform built specifically to showcase it in the right way. We are proud to support Repton with a platform built around ownership, governance and quality by design.”

pages.title: Rugby School signs with SOCS TV, Powered to Joymo, to launch… | Joymo

“Rugby School is setting a clear standard for how schools can share sport and wider school life in a way that strengthens community without compromising safeguarding. Through SOCS TV, powered by Joymo, Rugby School will have a secure, school-controlled digital home for live and on-demand content—so parents, families and alumni can feel close to the moments that matter, wherever they are. We are proud to support Rugby School with a platform built for education: ownership, governance and quality by design.”

pages.title: World Archery Partners With Joymo to Upgrade archery+… | Joymo

The relationship has seen Joymo develop and build a brand new archery.tv product, which will continue to be powered by Joymo, and broadcast the sport’s biggest events to subscribing audiences worldwide.
World Archery will exclusively stream marquee events like the Hyundai Archery World Cup, the Hyundai World Archery Championships and major regional tournaments on the platform, making it the single destination for archery fans to enjoy the sport.
archery+ will also host features, documentaries, educational resources and other exclusive content developed by World Archery, including qualification events for Paris 2024 and exclusive #ArcheryinParis content during the summer.
Commenting on the agreement, World Archery secretary general, Tom Dielen, said: “We’re partnering with Joymo to create a video hub for archery’s large catalogue of event and feature content, which will now be available in one location to every fan worldwide. Not only will this partnership make the sport easier to access but also allow us to invest additional resources into live production, engaging series and exciting new formats.”
Hannah Griffiths, VP of Content Acquisition & Partnerships at Joymo, said: “We are delighted that our technical expertise and experience in developing bespoke digital streaming solutions has been recognised by World Archery. This is exactly the type of full-cycle relationship that Joymo thrives on; creating and managing the product but also acquiring top-tier rights so that we are best positioned to support our partners in the long-term growth of their platforms.”
The full suite of archery+ live and exclusive content will be available to access with an annual subscription at a cost of €49.99. Pay-per-view event passes will also be available. Please visit archery.tv for more information.
